title: Theo and the Monsoon
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Theo Vasquez, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
